summary: Frontend-only test of /calculator PaymentCalculator (finance mode). All requested checks passed: defaults, live recalculation, edge cases (blank/0 price, cleared cash down, cash down > price), state change (Texas), tier/term change, lease toggle placeholder and restore, 2-col layout at 1920 / stacked at 390 with no horizontal overflow, card radius 4px / inputs+selects+toggle 2px, page title, other pages unaffected, zero console errors. vitest 10/10 pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Negative values (e.g. cash down -5000) can be typed; finance.js clamps to 0 so results are safe ($0 due at signing) but the input keeps showing -5000, so the input and the results disagree. min=0 only affects the spinner.

action_items: Optional: clamp or reject negative numbers in NumberField onChange (or show a validation hint)
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean: small focused components, testids present, toNum + money() guards stop NaN/Infinity, formatUsd/formatPct fall back to 0 for non-finite values.
The Due at signing row shows only cash down. Title/reg and fees are rolled into the amount financed. That is consistent but could be explained in the UI.

Price 0 with default cash down still shows doc/title/broker fees and $15,000 due at signing. This is acceptable, but cash down does not re-derive when the price changes (by design, since it is only the initial 10%).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified values: defaults $2,573/mo, AF $149,215, tax $12,795, doc $175, title $250, broker $995, DAS $15,000, interest $36,021, TOP $185,236. Cash cleared -> AF $164,215, $2,831/mo. Entrepreneur+60 -> 11.9% APR, $3,312/mo. Texas -> tax $9,375, doc $225, title $120, AF $145,715. Lease mode is still a placeholder; when it is implemented, test calcLease UI. '/' redirects to /process (title 'The Process').
